When I was growing up, we did Disney a LOT. One day my dad announced to the family that we were going again, just a few months after another trip. Our happy childhood memories were built on a mountain of debt, and my parents were not aligned. My mom later told me that that moment almost drove her to divorce my dad. As an adult, I don’t go on vacation unless I can pay for it in cash.
